observations.text:
HIDDENNESS CHALLENGES PERFECT DIVINE LOVE · PAULOGIA
"if I became convinced of it I'd become a Christian again"

Paulogia presents this conditional return as first-person evidence that intellectual doubt, rather than unwillingness to relate, explains his unbelief.

"

HIDDENNESS DOES NOT ESTABLISH THAT CHALLENGE · MICHAEL JONES
"freedom is still an essential part of who we are"

Jones argues that postmortem opportunity could preserve voluntary acceptance and difficult sanctification instead of making reconciliation automatic.
